official_syllabus.syllabus_identity: GSET/UGC-NET Forensic Science syllabus (UGC subject code 82; GSET subject code 27)

question_visual_proofreading.note: Scanned PDFs have been OCR-processed to support review, but OCR is not human visual proofreading. Do not mark source_verified until each stem and all options have been visually checked.

syllabus_mapping.note: Keyword-based unit suggestions are not verified. Manually confirm each question against its full context and official syllabus before promoting mapping status.

official_syllabus_unit_topics.1: Forensic science foundations, physical evidence, crime scene, investigation, courts, criminal profiling and quality control
official_syllabus_unit_topics.2: Microscopy, spectrophotometry, instrumental analysis, chromatography, electrophoresis and immunoassays
official_syllabus_unit_topics.3: Blood and body fluids, blood groups, DNA profiling, paternity and wildlife forensics
official_syllabus_unit_topics.4: Alcohol, drugs, poisons, pesticides, toxicology and chemical examination
official_syllabus_unit_topics.5: Firearms, ammunition, gunshot residue, ballistics and tool marks
official_syllabus_unit_topics.6: Fire, arson, explosives, bombs and forensic photography
official_syllabus_unit_topics.7: Hair, fibres, pollen, diatoms, soil, paint, glass, cement and digital/computer/mobile forensics
official_syllabus_unit_topics.8: Fingerprints, track marks and questioned documents
official_syllabus_unit_topics.9: Forensic medicine, forensic anthropology and identification
official_syllabus_unit_topics.10: Other forensic/legal/criminology areas requiring exact topic-level confirmation
